name: Frame Perfect Counter
description: Records a macro, replays it, then tests every input's timing leeway (in physics frames) and shows a frame-perfect histogram, like the 'frame perfect counter' videos on YouTube.

max-shift-frames.name: Max Shift (frames)
max-shift-frames.description: How many frames before/after the recorded time to test for each input when measuring its window.

test-horizon-frames.name: Survival Horizon (frames)
test-horizon-frames.description: How many frames after an input to keep checking for death before counting that attempt as a survive.

test-speed-multiplier.name: Test Speed Multiplier
test-speed-multiplier.description: How much to speed up the cocos2d scheduler while analyzing, so testing many inputs doesn't take forever in real time.

analyze-log-per-input.name: Log Every Input's Window
analyze-log-per-input.description: Write each input's measured window size to the mod's log / result file, not just the histogram.
